provider: HKUST 2025/26 Dual Degree Program in Technology and Management admissions and TEMG course catalog
note: The official admissions page lists five annual T&M Professional Activities courses and four named signature project/innovation courses. The 2025-26 TEMG catalogue confirms their codes, titles and credits. TEMG 4940 and TEMG 4950 carry 3-5 variable credits and TEMG 4970 carries 1-5, so each uses local credits 0 instead of assuming an endpoint. Students must pair one of 14 listed BEng/BSc options with one of six listed BBA options; each component Major has its own requirements, while waivers, substitutions and approved deviations may apply. This supplement exposes only the nine Programme-specific TEMG rows and does not copy or merge every component Major into a fabricated single curriculum. It remains a partial read-only list with totalCreditRequired=0 and must not produce a graduation-completion percentage.
